questions.question: Which subject was especially important to Romantic artists?
choices: Powerful emotion and the sublime force of nature

questions.question: What does 'the sublime' often describe in Romantic art?
choices: Awe mixed with fear before overwhelming natural forces or scale

questions.question: What was a central aim of Realist artists such as Gustave Courbet?
choices: Depict contemporary life and ordinary people without idealizing them
Use photography as the only medium

questions.question: Which subject would best fit a Realist painting?
choices: A legendary hero in an imaginary battle
A courtly fantasy with no contemporary reference

questions.question: How did industrialization affect some 19th-century artists?
choices: It changed urban life and labor, providing new subjects and conditions to respond to

questions.question: What was one goal of the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood?
choices: Return to detailed observation and vivid color inspired by earlier art

questions.question: Which material became widely available to artists during the 19th century and supported outdoor painting?
What did photography challenge artists to reconsider?
choices: Whether images could be made at all
The use of color in every medium
How painting could represent reality, time, and viewpoint

questions.question: Which movement is associated with artists who emphasized emotion and dramatic nature?
A painting depicts a contemporary city street and its ordinary residents. Which movement may be relevant?
What is one reason artists formed groups and exhibited outside official salons?
choices: They wanted to stop showing art publicly
They sought new audiences and alternatives to established institutions

questions.question: How did the growth of cities influence some 19th-century art?
choices: It ended the market for art
Artists responded to crowds, modern leisure, social change, and urban environments

questions.question: What is an example of historical context affecting an artwork's interpretation?
choices: Knowing the labor conditions surrounding a painting of workers can deepen its social meaning

questions.question: Which statement about 19th-century art is most accurate?
choices: It included several movements with different goals and responses to modern life

questions.question: Why might a Romantic landscape show a tiny human figure beneath mountains or a storm?
choices: To establish an exact population count
To hide the central subject accidentally
To contrast human scale with nature's vastness and power
To show a system of linear perspective only

questions.question: What did many Realist artists challenge?
choices: The use of all visible objects
Conventions that reserved serious art for idealized or heroic subjects

questions.question: Which choice best describes an art movement?
choices: A group or period of related artistic ideas and practices

questions.question: A painter chooses an unidealized scene of rural labor. What may the choice signal?
choices: Interest in representing ordinary work and lived conditions

questions.question: What is one way new technologies changed 19th-century artmaking?
choices: They eliminated the need for artists
They affected materials, image production, and artists' relationship to observation

questions.question: When comparing Romanticism and Realism, what is most helpful?
choices: Examine how each movement treats subject matter, emotion, and contemporary experience
